new_primary_source_intake.source: Watkins et al., Evaluating bulk flow estimators for CosmicFlows-4 measurements, MNRAS 526 (2023)
new_primary_source_intake.observed: Data Availability says simulated CF4 and 6dFGSv/CF4TF subsets may be shared upon request; SDSS mocks separately public at Zenodo 6640513. Section 2.4 says combined mocks stack SDSS, 6dFGSv, CF4TF; other distance methods and overlap are present in the actual CF4 catalog. Reported relative zero-point +/-0.017 is a sensitivity intervention, not source posterior or full covariance.

new_primary_source_intake.source: Watkins et al. linked author repository

source_map.released_table: source membership and marginal distances/uncertainties are available
source_map.parent_targeting: full upstream inclusion/rejection/inspection and distance-dependent normalizer unavailable

source_map.nulls: CF4TF and combined CF4 source mocks are request-only and still need proof of H02 statistic, group overlap, selection and calibration matching

source_conflicts_and_limits: CF4TF mock algorithm is for a constituent TF sample; it does not establish the complete 35,970 selected-group H02 joint law.
Combined bulk-flow mocks are designed for bulk-flow estimator tests, not automatically for H02 window/shape statistic or released-group distance likelihood.
A reported +/-0.017 log-distance-ratio zero-point injection does not estimate the joint shared calibration covariance.
The reviewed R23-DISTANCE conditional coverage of 3890/4096 is generated under an authored law; observed residual T criticizes that law.

issue.question: Can CF4/CF4TF source authors provide a versioned, no-auth release or direct authorized snapshot of the actual parent inclusion/rejection history, method/group and calibration ancestry with joint calibration/PV law, and H02-compatible source null catalogues or generator/seed/normalization contract?
issue.exact_missing_or_defect: Published released group/TF tables and scoped target-conditioned joins do not identify the parent targeting/detection/rejected-source probabilities or full shared calibration/group/PV covariance. The newly checked primary CF4TF and combined-CF4 papers explicitly put their realistic mock catalogues on author request; the public estimator repository only offers example mock input and code. Existing authored conditional law fails its actual-data residual diagnostic.
issue.risk: Treating selected-release fractions or synthetic conditional coverage as the source law would create unsupported physical precision and a false H02 PASS.

required: Versioned full CF4 parent targeting/observing/rejection and distance/quality selection history with source IDs and PGC-to-group/method ancestry, or an author-qualified inclusion/selection likelihood and normalization for the H02 selected cohort
Source-qualified joint relative/common/angular calibration covariance or posterior and group/peculiar-velocity covariance with explicit shared components and no-double-counting rule

Actual CF4 or constituent survey source null mock catalogues or reproducible generator/seed and calibration/selection contract sufficient to reproduce the source nulls for the fixed H02 statistic and method-group overlap
